lines.zh: 铁靴踏过黑石桥，一步一响。
lines.en: Iron boots ring across the blackstone bridge, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 下界合金甲压得肩头低了一寸。
lines.en: The netherite plate bows my shoulders down an inch.

lines.zh: 巡逻的路线，我闭着眼也能走。
lines.en: Every brick of this patrol route is memorized.

lines.zh: 金甲晃眼，专为吓退远处的人。
lines.en: This gold plate glares to scare off anyone far away.

lines.zh: 钻石甲每一片都磨得能照出火。
lines.en: Every diamond scale is polished bright enough to mirror fire.

lines.zh: 队形不能散，散了我先记你一笔。
lines.en: Keep the formation; break it and I mark your name.

lines.zh: 熔岩在桥下翻，我的脚步不乱。
lines.en: Lava churns beneath the bridge, and my stride never wavers.

lines.zh: 四档甲胄，我走的是最沉那档。
lines.en: Four grades of armor, and I march in the heaviest.

lines.zh: 铁甲轻，适合替新兵开路。
lines.en: Light iron suits me when clearing a path for recruits.

lines.zh: 别踩桥缝，那里的砖会响得远。
lines.en: Avoid the bridge seams; those bricks echo very far.

lines.zh: 我巡三圈，禁堡的门才敢合上。
lines.en: Only after three rounds does the bastion dare shut its gate.

lines.zh: 甲片互相磕碰，就是我报时的钟。
lines.en: Plates clashing together are the only clock I keep.

lines.zh: 我在数桥上的砖，一共九千块。
lines.en: I am counting the bridge bricks; nine thousand exactly.

lines.zh: 磨甲的石粉，比熔岩灰还细。
lines.en: The powder from my whetstone is finer than lava ash.

lines.zh: 鼻息喷在护腕上，凝成一层白。
lines.en: My breath fogs the bracer and freezes white.

lines.zh: 禁堡的风里有硫味，我闻惯了。
lines.en: The bastion wind smells of sulfur; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 金锭在腰袋里，我数过七遍。
lines.en: Seven times I have counted the gold in my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 谁在塔顶换岗，我听甲声就知。
lines.en: I know who swaps the watch by the sound of their armor.

lines.zh: 獠牙磕着护面，空隙太窄了。
lines.en: My tusks tap the faceplate; the gap is too narrow.

lines.zh: 这把斧头的刃口，昨天崩了一角。
lines.en: The edge of this axe chipped yesterday.

lines.zh: 下界合金重，可它从不退火。
lines.en: Netherite is heavy, but it never softens.

lines.zh: 坐下时护腿磕地，声音真钝。
lines.en: Sitting down, my greaves thud dull against stone.

lines.zh: 四档甲胄各有各的响，我分得清。
lines.en: Each armor grade sounds different; I can tell them apart.

lines.zh: 等换岗的鼓，鼓面早就破了一角。
lines.en: I wait for the relief drum, whose skin tore long ago.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你的甲是哪一档。
lines.en: Stand up; let me see which grade of armor you wear.

lines.zh: 你身上没有铁味，倒有草味。
lines.en: No iron smell on you; you carry the scent of grass.

lines.zh: 站远点，我的护肩比你的个头宽。
lines.en: Step back; my pauldrons are wider than you are tall.

lines.zh: 别摸剑柄，那动作我看得太熟。
lines.en: Do not touch that hilt; I know the motion too well.

lines.zh: 你数我甲上的铆钉做什么。
lines.en: Why are you counting the rivets on my plate?

lines.zh: 眼睛别躲，躲闪的人身上有洞。
lines.en: Do not look away; those who flinch have holes in their guard.

lines.zh: 金甲反光，会让你看不清我的斧。
lines.en: The gold glare hides where my axe actually is.

lines.zh: 你这身皮革，撑不过我一次撞击。
lines.en: That leather of yours will not survive one shove from me.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脚步了，别想绕后。
lines.en: I have your footfall now; do not try to circle behind.

lines.zh: 禁堡的客人，通常只来一次。
lines.en: Guests of the bastion usually come only once.

lines.zh: 甲凹了一块，得回炉重打。
lines.en: That dented one plate; it goes back to the forge.

lines.zh: 刃口崩了，你也别想好过。
lines.en: My edge chipped, and you will not fare better.

lines.zh: 这力道算重，够我记你一年。
lines.en: That counts as heavy; I will remember it a year.

lines.zh: 铁甲挡住了，骨头可没挡。
lines.en: Iron stopped it; my bones did not.

lines.zh: 护肩飞了，我捡回来再打。
lines.en: My pauldron flew off; I will fetch it and strike back.

lines.zh: 金甲软，这一下留了坑。
lines.en: Gold is soft; this blow left a pit.

lines.zh: 你打在接缝上，算你眼准。
lines.en: You hit the seam; credit to your eye.

lines.zh: 退半步，是为了把斧抡圆。
lines.en: I step back to swing the axe full circle.

lines.zh: 血从护面缝里渗，别装没看见。
lines.en: Blood seeps through the faceplate gap; do not pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 下界合金裂了纹，你得赔。
lines.en: Netherite just cracked; you owe me for that.

lines.zh: 那块金锭亮得刺眼，够换护腕。
lines.en: That gold ingot is blinding bright, enough for a bracer.

lines.zh: 你手里是下界合金？拿来我看看。
lines.en: Is that netherite in your hand? Hand it here.

lines.zh: 金锭放地上，我数三下。
lines.en: Set the gold on the ground; I count to three.

lines.zh: 别晃那块金子，我的眼睛会跟。
lines.en: Stop swinging that gold; my eyes will follow it.

lines.zh: 磨刀石也算好东西，我收下了。
lines.en: A whetstone counts as treasure; I will take it.

lines.zh: 这一小袋金粒，能换一次放行。
lines.en: This little pouch of gold buys you one crossing.

lines.zh: 护心镜缺了一块，你的金子正好。
lines.en: My breastplate has a gap, and your gold fits it.

lines.zh: 你把金锭举那么高，是在喂我吗。
lines.en: Holding that gold so high, are you feeding me?

lines.zh: 铁的也行，只要能铸成甲片。
lines.en: Iron will do too, if it can be hammered into scales.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，金子和手都归我。
lines.en: One more step and I take the gold and the hand.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞上你，桥面都颤了一下。
lines.en: My shoulder hits you and the whole bridge shudders.

lines.zh: 让开路，铁甲不长眼睛。
lines.en: Clear the road; iron plate has no eyes.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，能把人送下桥去。
lines.en: One shove from me can send a body off the bridge.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在响，一定是凹了。
lines.en: Your armor is creaking; something must be dented.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，甲片会咬人。
lines.en: Do not walk so close; my scales bite.

lines.zh: 退后，我肩上还扛着斧头。
lines.en: Back off; I am still carrying an axe on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下只是提醒，不是攻击。
lines.en: That was just a reminder, not an attack.

lines.zh: 桥这么窄，你非要和我并排。
lines.en: The bridge is narrow, yet you insist on walking beside me.

lines.zh: 重量就是道理，我比你有理。
lines.en: Weight is the argument, and I have more of it.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我把甲卸下来压你。
lines.en: Bump me again and I will drop this plate on you.

lines.zh: 甲胄先挂好，别刮花了护面。
lines.en: Hang the armor first; do not scratch my faceplate.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子，会先学会听甲声。
lines.en: Our children will learn the sound of armor first.

lines.zh: 你那件金甲，借我照一照。
lines.en: Lend me that gold plate to check my reflection.

lines.zh: 禁堡里成家的，都得会磨刃。
lines.en: In the bastion, anyone with a family learns to sharpen blades.

lines.zh: 别替我系扣带，我自己来。
lines.en: Do not buckle me in; I do it myself.

lines.zh: 今晚换岗后，桥头等你。
lines.en: After tonight's watch change, meet me at the bridgehead.

lines.zh: 你的甲比我的响，睡得我耳朵疼。
lines.en: Your armor rattles more than mine and keeps my ears sore.

lines.zh: 把斧头收进套里，孩子会碰。
lines.en: Sheathe the axe; the little ones will touch it.

lines.zh: 四档甲胄里，我只挑护得住你的。
lines.en: Of four grades, I pick only what shields you.

lines.zh: 我们守同一段墙，这就够了。
lines.en: We guard the same stretch of wall; that is enough.

lines.zh: 谁掉的护腕？拿来我补上。
lines.en: Whose bracer is this? Give it here to patch.

lines.zh: 铁片捡回去，还能再打一副。
lines.en: Iron scraps go home and become another set.

lines.zh: 这块钻石，够镶一档甲。
lines.en: This diamond is enough to set one armor grade.

lines.zh: 金锭归我，别问去哪儿。
lines.en: The gold comes with me; do not ask where.

lines.zh: 断剑的柄还能用，别扔。
lines.en: The hilt of that broken sword still works; keep it.

lines.zh: 下界残骸一片，我盯了很久。
lines.en: A scrap of netherite, watched over a long while.

lines.zh: 护腿碎成三块，我捡了两块。
lines.en: The greave broke in three; I saved two pieces.

lines.zh: 地上的甲片，都算禁堡的财产。
lines.en: Armor plates on the ground belong to the bastion.

lines.zh: 熔岩边的东西，得用钳子夹。
lines.en: Things near lava need tongs, not fingers.

lines.zh: 这一堆废铁，够喂一次熔炉。
lines.en: This heap of scrap will feed the furnace once.

lines.zh: 那个拿弓的，先断他的弦。
lines.en: The one with the bow: cut the string first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太慢，我数到三就冲。
lines.en: Your steps are too slow; on three I charge.

lines.zh: 桥头那个归我，别跟我抢。
lines.en: The one at the bridgehead is mine; do not take it.

lines.zh: 看见你翻栏杆，就知道你要跑。
lines.en: Watching you climb the railing tells me you run.

lines.zh: 火把举太高，会照出你的位置。
lines.en: Hold the torch high and you show me where you stand.

lines.zh: 这个人的甲很薄，一撞就散。
lines.en: This one's armor is thin; one shove will scatter it.

lines.zh: 你换了站位，我也换了角度。
lines.en: You shifted position, so I shifted my angle.

lines.zh: 百步之外我就听见你的呼吸。
lines.en: I hear your breathing from a hundred paces off.

lines.zh: 别拿盾对着我，我看得见缝。
lines.en: Do not raise that shield; I can see the seams.

lines.zh: 先锁住腿，再谈斧头。
lines.en: First I take your legs; the axe can wait.

lines.zh: 躲在柱子后没用，盔缨露了。
lines.en: Hiding behind the pillar fails; your helm plume shows.

lines.zh: 禁堡里没有陌生人，只有目标。
lines.en: The bastion holds no strangers, only targets.

lines.zh: 那个贴墙磨刀的，磨得再快也慢。
lines.en: The one honing his blade by the wall is slow regardless.

lines.zh: 你数我的甲片，我就数你的破绽。
lines.en: You count my plates; I count your openings.

lines.zh: 我绕左，不是怕你，是怕你跑。
lines.en: I circle left not from fear, but so you cannot run.

lines.zh: 斧头压低，专等你抬盾那一下。
lines.en: Axe held low, waiting for the moment you lift that shield.

lines.zh: 你退到桥边，我就省了力气。
lines.en: Retreat to the bridge edge and you save me effort.

lines.zh: 甲再厚，脖子那一圈总是空的。
lines.en: However thick the plate, the neck ring stays empty.

lines.zh: 你数我的心跳，我数你的步子。
lines.en: You count my heartbeats; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 熔岩在右边，我只要守住左边。
lines.en: Lava on the right; I only need to hold the left.

lines.zh: 别换手拿武器，我看得清。
lines.en: Do not switch weapon hands; I am watching closely.

lines.zh: 我等你踩到第三块响砖。
lines.en: I wait for you to step on the third echoing brick.

lines.zh: 你喘得比刚才重，快了。
lines.en: You are breathing heavier than before; soon now.

lines.zh: 再往后退，你的背就贴着火了。
lines.en: One step further back and fire meets your spine.

lines.zh: 这身下界合金，值得你全力一击。
lines.en: This netherite is worth your strongest blow.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只要把路堵死。
lines.en: I do not chase; I simply close the road.

lines.zh: 你护着左肋，我就往右肩去。
lines.en: You guard the left ribs, so I go for the right shoulder.

lines.zh: 等你的火把烧短一截，我再进。
lines.en: I advance once your torch burns down a notch.

lines.zh: 这一斧落下去，砖缝都震开。
lines.en: The axe falls and the brick seams split apart.

lines.zh: 击退三十步，你自己数。
lines.en: Thirty paces of knockback; count them yourself.

lines.zh: 铁甲档的力道，够你贴墙。
lines.en: Iron-grade force will pin you to the wall.

lines.zh: 金甲换来的，是这一下更沉。
lines.en: Gold bought me a heavier swing than that.

lines.zh: 钻石甲不响，落点才响。
lines.en: Diamond plate stays silent; only the impact rings.

lines.zh: 下界合金的斧，切开铁像切灰。
lines.en: Netherite cuts iron the way it cuts ash.

lines.zh: 你挡得住刃，挡不住后面的力。
lines.en: You can stop the edge but not the weight behind it.

lines.zh: 两下，第一下卸甲，第二下卸人。
lines.en: Two blows: the first strips armor, the second strips you.

lines.zh: 别指望退，我的斧比你的腿长。
lines.en: Do not plan to back away; my axe outreaches your legs.

lines.zh: 护面挨了一下，我只是歪了歪头。
lines.en: You struck my faceplate; I merely tilted my head.

lines.zh: 獠牙也能咬，只是斧更快。
lines.en: My tusks can bite too, but the axe is quicker.

lines.zh: 禁堡的规矩，一击定输赢。
lines.en: The bastion rule: one strike decides it.

lines.zh: 斧背也重，砸在盾上一样断骨。
lines.en: The axe back is heavy too; it breaks bone through shields.

lines.zh: 这一下没中，砖替我挨了。
lines.en: That swing missed; the brick took it for you.

lines.zh: 铁甲新铸的，先拿你试刃。
lines.en: Fresh-forged iron; you will test its edge.

lines.zh: 我从塔影里出来，影子还留着。
lines.en: I step from the tower's shadow, and it lingers.

lines.zh: 这一档甲，我守的是第三道门。
lines.en: In this grade of plate I hold the third gate.

lines.zh: 换岗的鼓刚敲过，你来得不巧。
lines.en: The relief drum just sounded; your timing is poor.

lines.zh: 禁堡缺人手，也缺靶子。
lines.en: The bastion lacks hands, and also lacks targets.

lines.zh: 甲片刚上油，闻起来像雨。
lines.en: My plates are freshly oiled and smell like rain.

lines.zh: 上一队人走到桥中央就没影了。
lines.en: The last squad vanished at the middle of the bridge.

lines.zh: 我的斧口朝下，这是待客的礼。
lines.en: My axe edge points down; that is my courtesy.

lines.zh: 你若举着金锭，我或许慢一步。
lines.en: Raise a gold ingot and I might be one step slower.

lines.zh: 四档甲胄都在墙后，我排第一档。
lines.en: All four grades wait behind the wall; I stand in the first.

lines.zh: 火把照亮我时，我已经在近处。
lines.en: By the time the torch finds me, I am already close.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊来的是下一档。
lines.en: Do not shout; shouting brings the next grade up.

lines.zh: 熔岩边上长大的，火只是热风。
lines.en: Raised beside lava, I call fire warm wind.

lines.zh: 甲重，落地时我先找平衡。
lines.en: Heavy armor makes me find balance first on landing.

lines.zh: 禁堡没有水，这感觉真怪。
lines.en: The bastion has no water; this feels wrong.

lines.zh: 爆风掀了甲片，我耳朵还在响。
lines.en: The blast lifted my plates and my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在甲缝里，拔出来还你。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my seam; I will return it.

lines.zh: 咒文烫在甲上，像烙了个印。
lines.en: The spell burns onto my plate like a brand.

lines.zh: 猪灵也饿，只是不说。
lines.en: Piglins get hungry too; we just do not say so.

lines.zh: 雷打在桥上，我的甲成了铁砧。
lines.en: Lightning struck the bridge and my armor became an anvil.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我还在数甲片。
lines.en: As I fall, I am still counting my plates.
